content: 27:1,2 Yisas Pailat wot isumirei
Itum der ne Pris munon baraitari eng ne munon baraitari qei nob qiumuni qib qei Yisast big qamb nausi waramune uminer qamb ebetemirei.
Ende at touri wogub imurimari Pailat Rom gabman end isorei.
27:3-10 Yudas umorei

Ne Yudas, munon Yisas duiamor eng igo Yisas gar eng ende ba bumai waramb sumungasi ende ebet igamari gab borusi toubet wogub nomon qur qangang 30-ende bauor eng bo ba isub Pris munon baraitari eng nob munon barai qei nob wurisab qamar:
“Ye munon qomon boru ten eng munon qoregen eng duiam end waramari umibar eng.” Ende qamara wuri taui qamamir: “In qob ger ue, nonou borusianei.”
Qamarari nomon qur eng inorou munai mor end arir wogub isub wonomi ibiari umorei.
Pris munon barai eng nomon qur eng ba qamar: “Nomon qur e munon wuribirerimau nomon qur eng gab inorou nomon qur e nob sori me bigun.”
Ende qamara nomon qur end qob qamb nausi wogub ne nomon qur end munon egi baab igour ai eng taui wurisab ne ai eng bo munon mug is ginam end igour eng umari wuritumuni igorun qamb wugumirei.
Qanam end ne see ai eng unum ‘qeru’ end qamb igour.
Qob eng miteri qamarau munon Yeremaia qoan qamar eng irimanima. Ete qamarei, “Isrel munon, wuri nomon qur 30-ende munon eng taui qamb maribigumirei.
Nomon qur eng bo egi baab igour ai eng tau baumirei. Munon aib wonou qamar gas ende.”
27:11-14 Pailat Yisas qebiamorei
Yisas is Rom gabman menmant end nagasiari der qebi qamar: “Ne Yuda wurinou munon baraitari igoan qiyo?” Ne Yisas taui qamar: “Nonou gari mom quran eng.”
Ende qamara Pris munon baraitari eng ne munon barai ar eng der qob qei nob qamamir eng wo qob taui ger me wurinob qamarau.
Ende igama Pailat bo nob qamar: “Qob irou nonob quraur eng ne ger taui me wurinob qemerinenei ii?”
Ende qamar ego Yisas qob ger bais me nob qamara igu gabman baraitari aib eng misir qebebi igub igoai.
27:15-26 Pailat Yisas namt big waramar qamb imuriamorei
Togun gugum qen qau aib end Rom gabman munon uyort igour eng gari qas ar wuri waga qenen iua igour. End munon yurau aib eng munon uyort igour eng ger ar wurit waga isiner qamb Pailat qebi amirei.
Qen end munon igeig qoat ger uyort igoai, unum eng Yisas Barabas.
Munon yurau aib qiumuni igamari Pailat wuri qebi qamar: “Your ar wugine anit isi qamb misir igoumon? Yisas Barabas eng qiyo a Yisas munon inubersiau tari qamb igour eng?”
Pailat wo Yuda munon musub mom wuriimbigorei. Wuri Yisas mom siningot wogub waramb ebetemir end.
Pailat qut bigau nam qab end bugab igama ubeni qob wot big qamar: “Ne munon qoregen eng meimi ger me wot eb. Itum inab inigi wo gaum end oau quguraget igoum,” ende qamarei.
Ne Pris munon ne munon barai ar qei der munon yurau wurinob qamarari Pailat nob qamarari Barabas wurit waga yara Yisas waramari um qamb qamamirei.
Qamarari Pailat bo der munon wuriqebi qamar: “Munon ombur e, your eng ar wugine anit isiner qamb qenungoumon?” Ne wuri qamamir: “Barabas.”
Ne Pailat bo wuriqebi qamar: “Ende gab Yisas Munon inubersiau tari qamb igour eng ye mai sieribam?” Wuri qamamir: “Nam tenori big warama uminer,” qamamir.
Ne Pailat bo qamar: “Wo meimi qomon boru ger ebeterei igama waramboumon?” Ne wuri misiringet qugiab qamb amir: “Nam tenoribig waramb qas wagar.”
Ende abari Pailat bo sabar qamb igama eng nob yogurubari gab ne ya ba munon magqurt wonou uben birogoni wogub wurinob qamar: “Munon e uminer eng ye mindigar qob ger yet me igorinerei, aninou qas.”
Ne munon yurau aib eng taui qamamir: “Munon eng uminer eng qarabab eng ininou init yar imusi ininou wau eng wurit isiner eng qob ue.”
Ende qamarari Pailat Barabas ar wurit imurima isa ne Yisas ba waramb wogub ba erer urimar qamb imurima wurit isorei.
27:27-31 Yogorau munon Yisas ber qob wot qamb igurei
Ne Pailat wonou yogorau munon yurau eng Yisas mot gabman munai end isari munon yurau aib yar qouiamirei.
Ende at wonou mi goan eng beasimetet ne bo mi goan mian nob ger qumanimetetemirei.

Ne uyor qer nob ger ba mebir barsi ne tarit end bugamsitet ne gotau ba uberegent end utari baurei. Baia ne menmant end gamaur wot bugab ber qob nob qamamir: “Ne Yuda wurinou munon barai qenen igomot igamau eng ne e?”
Ende qamb wot mui a gotau baub igoar eng wot ba tari qer omboipi,
ende at wot igerig wogub mi goan mian qumanimetetemir eng boair ne wonou mi goan eng bo qumanimetet. Ende at wogub big waramb qamb nob isumirei.
27:32-44 Yisas big waramirei
Nob isub igo ne qataben gamir eng Sairini munon ger unum Saimon, wo gab Yisas nam togor isub igoar eng wo bo bai qamb qamarari baurei.
Baia is ai Golgota qamb igour end isumirei. (Unum Golgota qanam eng, ‘ai qaur munon tari gas ende’).
Isub ya ger ya uter nob biiges utari nub git uter meinsi qamb utemirei. Ego Yisas wo imbig bo me niau.
Ende aba erer big waramb wogub wonou mi goan eng qerei baub qamb sauamirei.
Ende at ne qoat naget igurei.
Yisas big waramirt tarit erer end mindigar qob wot qamb waramir qanam eng ete qamb gumat bigumirei: MUNON E YISAS YUDA WURINOU MUNON AIB ende qamb gumatemirei.
Yisas wobon big waramir eng igama uberegent wes end munon mindigar qob ten eng ger big waramirei ne ger qagit end big waramb ende ebetemirei.
Ende igama munon yamangar tap eng isub di ende at qib igo Yisas gab tari misimat ete qamb-qamb qib igurei:
“Munon eng inorou munai aib Tempel eng bapami qen ombur garit mindat ugeibam qamb igoan end. Ne apand Qenu wau igo gab eng nam tenori big nanamour eng norumi ag der.”
Ende qamarari Pris munon barai ne qomon qerei imbig igour eng ne munon baraitari qei der qob eng gari nob qamamir:
“Wo apand Isrel wurinou munon baraitari igo gab eng ag deriner. Wo munon ar wurimusub igoar end wonomi ende bo musia eng in apand wot oabiguboun.
Wonou Qenut oabig ne qamar end, ‘ye Qenu wonou wau ten’ qamar end Qenu wot apand oabig qamb igama eng wagari qi gab igumune nerima dara gun.”
Ende qamarari ne munon boru ig-ig big igaramir eng gor der ber qob ende gari wot qamamirei.
27:45-56 Yisas umorei
Yisas uriamir eng ende igama worom ginam tog yara ne ai gugum ituramorei.
Itumoramor eng ende igama igoi worom qumat dara ne bo begenerib pisia ne Yisas qugiab qamb ar: “Eli, Eli lema sabaktani.” Qob eng qanam eng ete: ‘Yonou Qenu, meimet qamb ye wogan,’ ende.
Ende ara ne munon qei qani naget igour eng ende igub qamamir: “Wo Elaiya wot ara.”
Ende qamb ger der uyab-uyab isub uyer ya ger ba ya ger nob yisir waari wogub qagab gotaut touri wogub Yisas wariges ni qamb uterei.
Ende aba qei der qamamir: “Qi wagari gun, Elaiya wot arar eng der musia guboun.”
Ende qamb igamari Yisas bo sasam qugiab ende qamb ab wogub umorei.
Ende aba mi goan aib tempel mor uriamir eng metut qitet quburab is durum qumot waser ig-ig isorei. Ne ai aib uyab nomon aib-aib quburabriamorei.
Ende aba munon teter eng undounder ubura munon qoan Qenut oabig umbriamir eng igomot der isumirei.
Ende igamari ne Yisas igomot der bogoma ne wuri ginam aib end isari munon gugum ibagamirei.
Ne yogorau munon baraitari wonou yurau oromar Yisas qoat igour eng ai uyab mi gugum undounder ubura gab borusi yari wogub qamamir: “Sig apand mom, e Qenu wonou wau apand.”
Ne Galili yamangar yurau wurinou ginam wogub Yisas toat nob yaremir eng wuri gor mugenderi ete naget igurei.
Yamangar yurau eng igour eng erobon end ger eng Makdala Maria eng ne ger eng Yems Yosep nob unor Maria eng, ne ger eng Sebedi wonou wau ombur eng wurinou unor eng ende oramar end igurei.
27:57-61 Yisas tumuniamirei
Ende igamari worom nerimba ne Arimatea munon aib ger unum Yosep, wo gor Yisas wonou imbigau yurau ger.
Wo yar Pailat nob Yisas mumun end nob qamarei. Qamara Pailat yogorau munon wurinob qamara Yisas mumun Yosept wugumirei.
Wagari Yosep Yisas mumun nam erer igoar eng beneri ba ago big ba mi goan temen oannob ger ba mumun waat wogub,
ba bisub wonou tumun ger nomon irut barsi wager end bisub tumuni wogub nomon aib ger gingoai ba yar tumun qabar qipiot wogub isorei.
Ende aba ne Makdala Maria eng nob Maria ger eng nob tumun qani end bugab musub gab igurei.
27:62-66 Yogorau munon Yisas tumun qoat igurei
Barim eng inorou qen aib end ne Pris munon barai eng ne Parisi ende isub Pailat nob qiumuniamirei.
Qiumuni ne qamamir: “Barai, munon qetopur qamarau tari eng wo igom igo ete at qamar eng in misir igoun, ‘ye umb qen ombur gari ubura ne bo igomot der bugembam.’

Ende qamar end ne ne yogorau munon musub wurinob qamara tumun musub qoat igamari qen ombur gari ubura ne wogunor. Wonou imbigau yurau at mumun urim ba iua wabi wogub munon wurimurimar, ‘Yisas igomot der bogomai’ qomorunor qamb. Qob see qetopur qomorunor eng sig boru aib qoan qetopur qamamir wotanamimba.”
Ende qamarari Pailat wurinob qamar: “Yogorau munon qei ibag oramar isub aninou ebet igoumon gas ende tumun mom nausi opuramar.”
Ende qamara isub tumun mom nausi opur wogub ne qani me isar qamb biru big wogub bur tuum wuri qereimari tumun qoat igurei.
